overall_assessment: Section extraction for uib works well: heading map is accurate, sections are complete and clean in all random controls and most suspects, and admin headings are dropped correctly. Remaining problems are a heading-only page whose heading list was emitted as course_content, and corona-related sentences silently removed from assessment/coursework text.

findings.description: The plan page contains only the list of headings and no body text. The extractor emitted the heading names themselves (after the first heading) as a 434-char course_content row, instead of emitting no sections. The row is junk: it contains no course content, and the pre-pass flags (blob, leak->...) are real here.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: When every heading is followed immediately by another heading, the reader/text fallback treats the first heading 'Emnebeskrivelse'/'Mål og innhold' as having body text equal to the rest of the page's heading lines; section cleaning does not detect that a block consists only of known heading strings.
findings.suggested_fix: In sectionize()/.clean_sections() drop any section whose lines are all (after trimming) recognised headings from the heading map (or the unmapped/.drop headings); emit no row so the course shows 'no sections', same as uib_KJEM399K-0_2011_autumn_1.

findings.evidence: NB.  er munnleg eksamen erstatta av 6 timar skriftleg eksamen heimefrå som tiltak for å hindre spreiing av koronavirus.
findings.description: The sentence is in the plan but dropped from extracted assessment, leaving 'NB. Studentane får 1 time teknisk tilleggstid, slik at dei har 7 timar...' with a dangling NB (the form of exam is lost). In coursework_requirements the sentence 'På grunn av koronasituasjonen vil det ikkje vere obligatorisk frammøte .' was likewise removed, leaving an orphaned 'Det er likevel sterk oppmoding...'. Text is incomplete relative to the plan.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: A cleanup step (likely in .clean_sections() or the anonymizer's sentence-level removal) deletes sentences matching corona/koronavirus/koronasituasjonen patterns (or the sentence with the anonymized gap), cutting content mid-paragraph.
findings.suggested_fix: Find the rule that removes these sentences (grep for 'korona' in R/extract_sections.R and R/anonymize*.R); either keep the text or remove the whole 'Gjelder vårsemesteret 2021:' block consistently, rather than single sentences.

findings.description: The placeholder 'Ingen' / '-' from 'Krav til forkunnskaper' is concatenated with the real recommended prerequisite from 'Anbefalte forkunnskaper' without distinguishing required from recommended; the pre-pass 'empty' flag on a 14-char section is a false alarm for content but shows the placeholder is kept inside the text. In uib_KJEM399K-0_2011_autumn_1 a lone 'Ingen' prerequisite produced no section at all (fine).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Both 'Krav til forkunnskaper' and 'Anbefalte forkunnskaper' map to prerequisites and are joined; placeholder stripping is applied only to whole sections.
findings.suggested_fix: Strip placeholder-only blocks ('Ingen', 'Ingen.', '-') before joining blocks of the same section in .clean_sections().
